container_privileged_mode_disabled.title: Container not running in privileged mode
container_privileged_mode_disabled.description: Attests the container is NOT privileged (HostConfig.Privileged=false). Privileged dissolves seccomp+MAC+all caps+host devices — the largest escape-to-host-root primitive. true=secure; fires on is_false.

container_capabilities_dropped_to_minima.title: Linux capabilities dropped to minimal set
container_capabilities_dropped_to_minima.description: Attests CapDrop=[ALL] with minimal non-dangerous CapAdd — none of CAP_SYS_ADMIN/CAP_SYS_PTRACE/CAP_SYS_MODULE/CAP_DAC_READ_SEARCH/CAP_NET_RAW. true=secure; fires on is_false.

container_host_namespaces_not_shared.title: Host PID/IPC/network namespaces not shared
container_host_namespaces_not_shared.description: Attests PidMode/IpcMode/NetworkMode are NOT 'host' — none collapses namespace isolation. true=secure; fires on is_false.

container_no_sensitive_host_mounts.title: No Docker socket or sensitive host bind-mounts
container_no_sensitive_host_mounts.description: Attests no bind-mount of /var/run/docker.sock or host /, /proc, /sys, /var/lib/docker. docker.sock = full daemon control / host takeover. true=secure; fires on is_false.

container_seccomp_and_mac_profile_enforc.title: Seccomp and MAC confinement enforced on the container
container_seccomp_and_mac_profile_enforc.description: Attests seccomp is default/custom allowlist (NOT unconfined, NOT forced-off by privileged) AND an AppArmor/SELinux MAC profile is active. Both jointly block the CVE-2022-0492 cgroup release_agent escape. true=secure; fires on is_false. Scoped to THIS workload, not host-wide MAC.

container_no_new_privileges_and_nonroot.title: No-new-privileges set and container-root is not host-root
container_no_new_privileges_and_nonroot.description: Attests no_new_privs is set AND the workload is not host-root (non-zero UID, or userns-remap maps container UID0 to an unprivileged host UID). true=secure; fires on is_false.

container_runtime_patch_current.title: Container runtime patched at or above fixed builds
container_runtime_patch_current.description: Attests runc/containerd/engine at-or-above escape-fix builds: runc >= 1.1.12 (CVE-2024-21626) and past 1.0-rc6 (CVE-2019-5736). true=secure; fires on is_false. Scoped to the container runtime, not host OS packages.

container_readonly_root_filesystem.title: Container root filesystem is read-only
container_readonly_root_filesystem.description: Attests ReadonlyRootfs=true so an attacker with code-exec cannot persist tooling, overwrite in-container binaries, or stage the runc-overwrite escape step. true=secure; fires on is_false.

container_resource_limits_enforced.title: Container cgroup resource limits enforced (memory + CPU + PIDs)
container_resource_limits_enforced.description: Attests bounded cgroup limits across memory (Memory>0), CPU (NanoCpus/CpuQuota/CpuShares set), and PIDs (PidsLimit>0). true=secure; fires on is_false. Unbounded → host RAM exhaustion / CPU starvation / PID fork-bomb (noisy-neighbour DoS).

container_image_pinned_and_signature_ver.title: Image pinned to immutable digest and signature/content-trust verified
container_image_pinned_and_signature_ver.description: Attests the image is referenced by an immutable @sha256 digest (not a mutable :latest) AND its signature/content-trust is verified (Cosign/Sigstore or DOCKER_CONTENT_TRUST=1). true=secure; fires on is_false.

container_image_free_of_embedded_secrets.title: No secrets/credentials embedded in image layers
container_image_free_of_embedded_secrets.description: Attests no plaintext credentials/keys/tokens baked into layers/ENV/build-args; secrets injected at runtime only. true=secure; fires on is_false.
